proofBoundary: Counted ordered configuration updates over a successful opaque compiler result with the same parser registry and hash algorithm. Affected ownership closure and every staged object are validated. Candidate-only auxiliary COW bindings exclude newly proven live dependencies; remaining candidates are pruned using one reference scan. Final output matches fresh compilation and an independent Patricia oracle across all five hashes. Fieldless, unchanged-dependency replacement and distinct-dependency scaling guards, publication-boundary failures/pressure/retry, source/cancellation/allocator failures, exact counts and physical reopen preserve the original closure and never select HEAD. In-memory proof metadata is not a new wire format. This does not admit arbitrary persisted roots or supply durable task pins.

adjacentCorrection: The shared semantic-state encoder now returns typed host-allocation failures for its bounded body and output buffers. Direct tests cover both buffers, both availability forms and all five hashes. Original output/body SIGABRT failures are retained as evidence. Existing namespace codec functions are unchanged except those two allocation expressions and an appended helper; audit positions do not move.
